name: Microsoft Azure Log Analytics
mapping: Microsoft Azure Log Analytics Default Mappings
description:
This plugin supports ingestion of Alerts (DLP, Malware, Policy, Compromised Credential, Malsite, Quarantine, Remediation, Security Assessment, Watchlist, UBA, CTEP, Device, Content), Events (Page, Application, Audit, Infrastructure, Network, Incident, Endpoint, Client Status) and WebTx data into Microsoft Azure Log Analytics Workspace Table. This plugin supports ingestion in CEF and JSON format. 
Note: CEF is only supported in 'Single Table' mode.

configuration.label: Directory (tenant) ID
configuration.description: Directory (tenant) ID of Microsoft Entra ID application.

configuration.label: Application (client) ID
configuration.description: Application (client) ID of Microsoft Entra ID application.

configuration.label: Client Secret
configuration.description: Client Secret of Microsoft Entra ID application.

configuration.label: Azure Cloud
configuration.description: Azure cloud in which the Microsoft Entra ID application and Log Analytics Workspace are hosted. The access token is requested from the selected cloud's Entra ID endpoint. Select 'Custom Cloud' for any other Azure cloud and provide the 'Custom Authority Host' and 'Custom Token Scope'.

configuration.label: Custom Authority Host
configuration.description: Microsoft Entra ID authority host of the Azure cloud, e.g. 'login.microsoftonline.us'. Provide the hostname only. Required only when 'Azure Cloud' is 'Custom Cloud'.

configuration.label: Custom Token Scope
configuration.description: Azure Monitor token audience (scope) of the Azure cloud, e.g. 'https://monitor.azure.us/.default'. '/.default' is added automatically if it is not provided. Required only when 'Azure Cloud' is 'Custom Cloud'.

configuration.label: DCR Immutable ID
configuration.description: Immutable ID of Data Collection Rule.

configuration.label: Log Source Identifier
configuration.description: This will be added in the 'Application' column of the destination custom log table(s).

configuration.label: Ingestion Mode

choices.key: Per Data Type (One Table Per Type)

configuration.description: Choose 'Single Table' to push every record into a single custom table inside a 'RawData' column. Choose 'Per Data Type' to push the selected data types into separate custom tables with one column per Netskope field. You must upload the schemas from the plugin guide to Azure before selecting the Ingestion Mode.

configuration.label: Custom Log Table Name
configuration.description: Custom Log Table name for ingesting all data. Every record (Alerts, Events and WebTx) is pushed into this table inside a 'RawData' column. The table must already exist in the Log Analytics Workspace.

configuration.label: Data Types to Ingest
configuration.description: Select the Netskope data types to ingest. A separate Custom Log Table is used for each selected data type; provide the table names below.
